title: Psoriasis molecular heterogeneity and multisystem shared genetic architecture: JDS reproducibility release
description: Versioned analysis-code and aggregate source-data release accompanying a Journal of Dermatological Science submission. Includes analysis scripts, configuration and environment files, aggregate figure source tables, and final figure exports. It excludes raw participant-level, controlled-access, GWAS summary-statistic, GTEx BESD, and local LD-reference files. Full upstream reanalysis requires retrieval of original data and references under their source access terms.
